title: Matched Excess-Outranker Regularization for Candidate-Set Interference in Continual Knowledge Graph Embedding
abstract: arXiv:2608.24273v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual knowledge graph embedding updates entity and relation representations as a graph grows. Existing methods primarily address catastrophic forgetting, but entity admission also changes the candidate universe of every compatible query. A historical answer can therefore lose rank even when its score and its ordering among old entities are preserved. We formalize this effect as candidate-set interference and introduce Matched Excess-Outranker Regularization (MEOR), a host-level objective that compares smooth answer-relative newcomer pressure with score-blind, structurally matched old references. Its one-sided penalty acts only when newcomer competition exceeds the matched reference, preserving the host learner's signal for legitimate new entities. translated_title: 匹配超额超越正则化用于持续知识图谱嵌入中的候选集干扰
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24273v1 公告类型：新 摘要：持续知识图谱嵌入随着图的增长更新实体和关系表示。现有方法主要解决灾难性遗忘，但实体接纳也会改变每个兼容查询的候选空间。因此，即使历史答案的得分及其在旧实体中的排序保持不变，其排名也可能下降。我们将此效应形式化为候选集干扰，并引入匹配超额超越正则化（MEOR），这是一种宿主级目标，比较平滑的答案相对新来者压力与得分无关、结构匹配的旧参考。其单边惩罚仅在新来者竞争超过匹配参考时生效，从而保留宿主学习器对合法新实体的信号。在ENTITY-ComplEx上的八组配对运行中，与重放相比，MEOR将历史当前宇宙平均倒数排名（MRR）提高了0.0057，并将候选集干扰减少了0.0055，同时...
tldr: 本文提出MEOR正则化方法，通过单边惩罚新实体竞争以缓解持续知识图谱嵌入中的候选集干扰，提升历史答案排名稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MEOR regularization to mitigate candidate-set interference in continual knowledge graph embedding via one-sided penalty on newcomer competition, improving historical answer ranking stability.
